rationale: F1: the only family whose structural trade count (~19 validation trades) can meet the 15-trade minimum on daily data.
F2: decisions once a week keep cost drag low (cost-horizon study: weekly moves ~5x round-trip cost).
F3: diversifies across coins; feasible from $20 on Coinbase (capital-tier study).
Parameters are the longest/most conservative grid values; no new parameter was introduced.
disclosures: Chosen by an agent that has seen the historical results of all 199 candidates (all rejected). Historical data is NOT evidence for these rules; only forward months after startAt count.
Power is low: ~12-24 forward months can only confirm very large edges (STATISTICAL_CONFIDENCE_VALIDATION.md). Holding cash remains the expected outcome.
Paper only. Activation (status 'active' + startAt) is an owner decision. Any rule change = new registration, clock restarts.

P0 (2026-11-26): costSnapshot records the cost values the experiment was activated with (outside the v1 hash; the evaluator refuses drift).
